# KADD Change Request — Layer 5 and Layer 9 Governance Closure

**Status:** Proposed  
**Date Submitted:** 2026-11-16  
**Submitted By:** Local KADD Governance Review  
**Priority:** High  
**Layer:** 5 and 9  
**Owner:** Prismata Architecture Team

---

## Change Summary

Close the governance loop for the post-implementation and reference layers by validating the research, lessons learned, retrospective, glossary, and reference updates as one synchronized review cycle.

## Affected Documents

- `canonical/kadd/5-post-implementation/5-01-research.yaml`
- `canonical/kadd/5-post-implementation/5-02-lessons-learned.yaml`
- `canonical/kadd/5-post-implementation/5-03-retrospectives.yaml`
- `canonical/kadd/9-reference/9-01-glossary.yaml`
- `canonical/kadd/9-reference/9-03-references.yaml`

## Finding

Layer 5 and Layer 9 work together to preserve project memory, governance continuity, and durable discovery. The current improvements make the two layers function as a coherent living knowledge system rather than isolated documentation islands.

## Rationale

The value of the KADD collection increases when adjacent layers are reviewed together. This allows the project to treat knowledge capture, governance traceability, and reference clarity as a single lifecycle rather than as unrelated maintenance tasks.

## Suggested Change

- keep the Layer 5 lifecycle conceptually synchronized with Layer 9 reference materials
- maintain template and workflow references in a governance-aware way
- review both layers together in each operational cycle
